text: 1.The Applicant should be expected to study hard, observe the laws and decrees of the Chinese government and abide by the regulations of BUAA. 2.In general the applicant must have a master's degree or have the equivalent educational background of a master's degree. 3.The applicant should be forty-five years of age or under. 4.The applicant must pass the entrance examination organized by the university 5.He/she must have a good command of English and have the ability to take courses in English or Chinese.
